front.title: Subscription Flow Control Extension for Media over QUIC Transport

abstract.t: This document defines an extension to Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) that lets a subscriber limit the number of subgroup streams and the total bytes a publisher may send for an individual subscription. It defines a Setup Option to negotiate the extension and set initial limits, message parameters for advertising these limits, messages for granting credit and signaling flow control state, and a session error code.
